name: B10-0047/2024 (S&D) – The deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the ‘Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice’
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises the Taliban's new morality law, which forces women to cover fully, travel with a male guardian and stay silent in public. The Parliament asks the Taliban to cancel the law and respect international commitments. It asks the European Union to fund an independent United Nations investigation, back the International Criminal Court's work, send humanitarian aid and visas to persecuted women, and support Afghan civil society. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Taliban is urged to scrap its morality law; Afghan women and girls are most affected.
- The European Union is asked to fund a United Nations investigation and back the International Criminal Court.
- The European Union is asked to send aid and humanitarian visas and support Afghan civil society.
